verdict.rationale: Canny ships an official MCP server for ChatGPT, Claude, and Cursor with secure sign-in. Its feature page says users can ask their LLM what customers asked for and dig into top themes and ARR impact across ideas, which matches the story directly. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the MCP tools or queries for theme and revenue analysis beyond marketing copy, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the ARR-impact queries work as claimed.
